why: In X the arm bar is bent up at the right end. In a mirror left and right swap, so the bend goes to the left end and still points up. That is option 2. Option 4 has the bend on the left but it points down, which a side mirror cannot do.
trick: A side mirror never changes up into down; it only swaps left and right.
